title: stories create --brief drops the brief unless --with-assignment is passed
description: Reported by the Machines on Machines session, 2026-11-05: papyrus stories create --brief silently drops the brief unless --with-assignment is also given, with no warning. It should keep the brief, or refuse with a clear message. Also from today: papyrus references capture-thumbnails --site does not reach the upload step, so with several sites signed in it fails with an AuthError unless papyrus --site is given before the group.
